changeSet.sql:
Create or alter procedure Queue.DeleteQueueTaskRecords as begin declare @RetentionDate datetime = convert(date,dateadd(dd, -14, getutcdate()))
If exists (select 1 from [Queue].[Task] Where [Date] < @RetentionDate) begin -- Removing record less then retention date BEGIN TRANSACTION; SAVE TRANSACTION QueueDeleteSavePoint;
BEGIN TRY delete from [Queue].[Task] Where [Date] < @RetentionDate
COMMIT TRANSACTION END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK TRANSACTION QueueDeleteSavePoint; -- rollback to MySavePoint END END CATCH End End
